tagline.en_US: FreshRSS is a self-hosted RSS and Atom feed aggregator.

description.en_US: FreshRSS is a self-hosted RSS and Atom feed aggregator. It fetches updates from multiple websites and organizes them into a centralized reading interface. It enables users to follow news, blogs, and other web content without relying on third-party feed reader services.

tips: Complete the initial installation and database setup via the web interface upon first opening the application.
